name: Preservation/Acquisition

name: Processing

name: Analysis
description: Preservation, traceability, statistical, protocols, data mining, timeline, link, visualisation

description: Traceability, transparency, clarification, checking the CoE/CoC

name: Presentation
description: Documentation, expert testimony, clarification, mission impact statement, recommended countermeasures, and statistical interpretation.

name: Archiving
description: Long term preservation of original sources, found artefacts, used tools and hardware
